verdict.rationale: Model-file portability is a fair question for a local LLM runtime, but nothing in the pack documents where LM Studio stores downloaded models, what format they are in, or whether other runtimes can reuse them without re-downloading or re-converting. Mentions of Hugging Face downloads and llama.cpp/MLX engines describe how LM Studio runs models, not whether its files are shareable. One community user switched to Ollama to manage all downloads in one app, which hints at no sharing, but it is not evidence either way of a documented capability.
